procedure: - Preserve client-specific RGB values in `ClientConfig.theme`; expose semantic colors and radii through `layout.tsx`, `globals.css`, and `tailwind.config.ts`.
- Prefer source-owned primitives in `src/components/ui` over one-off button/card/dialog styling. Add only the primitives the product uses.
- Use Lucide for generic interface icons. Keep icons decorative when adjacent text supplies the accessible name; label icon-only controls.
- Keep Anime.js as the sole general-purpose animation engine. Reuse `src/lib/motion/tokens.ts`, keep movement restrained, and preserve visible no-JavaScript/reduced-motion content.
- Keep native page scrolling. Do not place scroll interception or entrance animation over the Google Appointment Scheduling iframe.
- Keep generic behavior client-neutral; do not embed Dr. Alexia-specific presentation logic in shared components.
